findings.finding: The available control material does not contain the D141 final four-way commit/tree tuple or recorded MAIN GO.
findings.impact: No body can be dispatched or credited.
findings.action: Wait for the immutable cut record; fill the null final pins only from that record.

findings.finding: Existing D66 selectors support P1, P3, and the six requested P2 gestures without a new harness.
findings.impact: A bounded recipe can be handed to the central service after the hard gate clears.
findings.action: Use the named selectors and exact original grep predicates in recipe.json.

findings.finding: P2 SWAP and Element are explicit owner-morning-cut exclusions.
findings.impact: The packet cannot claim broad P2 qualification or weaken predicates for the six included routes.
findings.action: Keep the exclusions out of the D141 body and retain their known gaps.

findings.finding: AST hashes were not recorded in the retained qualified evidence for P1, the six P2 selectors, or P3.
findings.impact: If the D141 cut requires AST hashes, admission remains incomplete.
findings.action: Obtain them from the cut record or existing provenance; do not compute them by collecting or changing sources.

findings.finding: P4 and P5 remain Agent/Runtime-owned lanes.
findings.impact: App must not add duplicate P4/P5 controllers.
findings.action: Hand off the final tuple, MAIN GO, and normal-route pointers only.

decision_log: Historical qualified tuples are retained as evidence pointers, not reused as final pins.
The existing individual D66 selector routes are used; no generic harness or fixture rewrite is introduced.
No execution was requested because D141 explicitly stops before all three heads are final and MAIN GO is recorded.
